dedicated.name: Eileene's Rapier

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Eileene survive Critical Hits more easily.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Eileene by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"Keep this. Its powers may have spiraled out of control, but you were still the one who inherited Rachel's strength. Use it to repay the kindness Rachel showed protecting you."

Cradling the wounded Rachel in her arms, Vanessa comforted the guilt-ridden Eileene and revealed the truth: Rachel was still alive. Vanessa handed Rachel's rapier to Eileene, urging her to use it to repay Rachel's kindness. Through this act, Eileene steeled her resolve to rise above her sorrow and stand tall once again.

lore:
With a ground-shaking roar, Gelidus's attack descended upon the battlefield with ferocious intensity. Overwhelmed by the relentless barrage, Eileene found herself on the brink of defeat. Without a moment's hesitation, Rachel threw herself in harm's way and took the devastating blow in her friend's place.
Frozen in shock, Eileene reached out toward Rachel, who was slowly fading away amidst Agni's flames. Rachel offered a faint smile before speaking out in a soft, low voice.

"Gosh, Eileene... you really are... such a crybaby..."
"Why is it that you always..."

Unable to finish her sentence, Eileene broke down in tears. Rachel gently touched her friend's cheek before her hand limply fell away. Eileene desperately tried to hold onto Rachel's warmth, but all that remained in her grasp was Rachel's rapier — an object that still carried the will that Rachel had left behind.
Her surging grief soon gave way to burning rage directed at Gelidus, and Eileene tightened her grip around the rapier, her knuckles turning white with the strain.

"I will carry on your Will of Fire...! Let's go together... Rachel!"

As her uncontrollable fury erupted, the power of incendiary flames began to rise within Eileene's very being.
